A motion was made by Commissioner Uriarte Smith, to elect Vice Chair
Redfield for Chair of the Parks and Recreation Commission. The
motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  6  Allen, Chavez, Schoen, Uriarte Smith, Redfield, Livingstone
No:  0  None
Recused: 0  None
Abstain: 0  None
Absent: 1  Higa

A motion was made by Vice Chair Redfield, to elect Commisioner Uriarte
Smith for Vice Chair of the Parks and Recreation Commission. The
motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  6  Allen, Chavez, Schoen, Uriarte Smith, Redfield, Livingstone
No:  0  None
Recused: 0  None
Abstain: 0  None
Absent: 1  Higa

Chair Livingstone declared the nominations open for Chair.

Commissioner Uriarte Smith nominated Vice Chair Redfield as Chair of the
Parks and Recreation Commission.

There being no further nominations, Chair Livingstone declared the
nominations closed for Chair.

Vice Chair Redfield accepted the Chair of the Parks and Recreation
Commission nomination.

Chair Livingstone declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Vice Chair Redfield nominated Commissioner Uriarte Smith as Vice Chair of
the Parks and Recreation Commission.

There being no further nominations, Chair Livingstone declared the
nominations closed for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Uriarte Smith accepted the Vice Chair of the Parks and
Recreation Commission nomination.
